body.heading: One line each
paragraphs: The first person starts: One morning, a tiny door appeared in the garden fence.
Pass the toy to the next person. They add just one more line. Then it moves on again.

body.heading: Land the ending
paragraphs: When the story feels nearly finished, someone says: And from that day on... and adds the last line.
Clap for your story. Nobody could have told that exact story alone.

takeaway: When everyone adds a line, a story can wander to wonderful places.
safetyNotes: Keep stories friendly: everyone should feel happy listening.
screenFreeExtension: Start a story at breakfast and finish it at bedtime, one line at a time.
